verdicts.quote: She kept her head turned a little to the left, always, so the good eye covered the side the patch didn't.
verdicts.reason: Hesse has one good eye and a patch throughout, and turning her head left so her right eye covers her blind left side matches a left-eye loss; Rickard's line 'They've taken one already' agrees.

verdicts.quote: So she remembered. Of course she remembered. Hesse forgot nothing
verdicts.reason: Hesse hints at Marro's past as something she already knows and covers for him, while Rickard shows no knowledge of it and learns nothing ('Slavers?').
